column1: # tests/ci-shard-weights.tsv — measured per-fixture wall seconds, the input
# to the LPT bin-pack in tests/ci-shard-plan.py.
# Source: the ubuntu shape-checks job of GitHub Actions run 32583260063
# (2026-08-22), timed from the `--- RUN` markers the run_one harness emits.
# Windows and macOS are not separately measured; the RELATIVE ordering is
# what the pack needs, and it holds across the three runners.
# These are HINTS, never a gate. A fixture missing from this file is packed
# at DEFAULT_WEIGHT and still runs — the plan's completeness is asserted
# against the workflow's own list by tests/ci-wiring.test.sh W13, not
# against this file. Refresh it when the balance drifts; nothing breaks if
# it goes stale, the shards just even out less well.
